prompt: Create an original 90 second Middle Eastern acoustic instrumental instrumental composition for puzzle game, strategy and patient problem solving. Mood: curious, playful, precise. Instruments: oud, qanun, darbuka. Style: ornamented modal melody with rolling hand-drum rhythm. Tempo approximately 102 BPM; C lydian. Main idea: a compact three-note motif. Use offset accents and question-and-answer motifs without dramatic shocks. Instrumental only. No vocals, no choir, no humming, no singing, no speech, no lyrics, no vocal samples. Do not imitate any existing artist or melody. [00:00-00:30] Establish the main idea immediately with the core ensemble. [00:30-01:00] Develop the motif with a complementary instrumental counterline, preserving the intended energy. [01:00-01:30] Return to the main idea and give a musically resolved ending with a short natural tail. Finish around 01:30.

description.en: A lively and rhythmic Middle Eastern folk piece featuring a prominent oud melody, supported by traditional percussion and a melodic wind instrument. The arrangement is clean and engaging.
description.zh: 一首活泼且富有节奏感的中东民间音乐，以突出的乌德琴旋律为主，辅以传统打击乐器和旋律性管乐器。编曲干净且引人入胜。
